data.key_logic: This Oracle Service Cloud CPM PHP custom procedure code primarily handles the registration of contacts in Siebel through a SOAP request, and it sends an exception email if any errors occur during the registration process. The code uses the Connect PHP API and the Process Designer interface to interact with the Oracle Service Cloud and Siebel systems, respectively, and it logs various messages and responses for debugging purposes.
